title: Text editor: replace all occurrences
instruction: The text editor has ~/bench/essay.txt open. Replace every occurrence of the word colour with color in the whole file, then save it.
setup: for i in $(seq 1 25); do echo "The colour of item $i is nice."; done > "$B/essay.txt"
verify: ! grep -q colour "$B/essay.txt" && [ "$(grep -c '^The color of item [0-9]* is nice\.$' "$B/essay.txt")" = 25 ]
